title.narrative: Sustaining the achievement of Peace building in the diocese of Bujumbura

description.narrative: The security situation across Burundi remains volatile and church leaders remain among key figures in various negotiations and inclusive dialogues that are geared to promote peace, stability and social cohesion. So far, many donors have withdrawn their support from the country due to poor democracy and human rights abuses within the country by the party in power. In the past our, project have aimed at solving the issue of social cohesion between displaced, demobilized, returnees and residents in the hills around Bujumbura in Burundi. It is in that sense that our past entrance to address peace issues in our context were through SILC’s (Savings and Internal Lending Community) which offered a forum to discuss issues of common interest namely peace building and the challenges of cohabitation in the hills and therefore an opportunity to peaceful manage conflicts. Being at the exit stage, our current focus and aim is run some quick spot check with the leaders of 14 main parishes of the Archdiocese of Bujumbura and define together effective sustainability strategy to upkeep the achievements of the peace building program even with limited means in the diocese. CDJP Bujumbura will therefore organize meetings to sensitize the animators for their role in ensuring sustainability of past years achievements. We will as well aim at some advocacy activity with the annual archdiocese meeting to ensure and have the buy-in of the management board to strengthen the parishioner’s engagement in SILC movements.
